gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-encode-sans: Clean and neutral, Encode Sans holds its gaps wide enough that c never passes for o, however loud the heading above gets. Bruno Ace's joins are as stout as its stems, ruler-drawn throughout.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gantari: Ruler-drawn lines of constant width define Bruno Ace. Gantari's wire-bent look and wide c apertures give paragraphs an approachable, contemporary pace that carries the eye smoothly down a full column.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-google-sans: Google Sans runs without thick-thin shifts, its terminals pulled well back. Bruno Ace is happiest in large, brief headings, where its ruler-drawn line and lingering rhythm get room to show.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gruppo: Gruppo is a sans whose curve endings never crowd one another, and it reads clean. But Bruno Ace draws its whole line at a constant width, lingering one character per beat.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-gudea: Counters that stay connected to the outside give Bruno Ace its ruler-drawn, lingering look, one character per beat. Shrink the heading and its flair fades, while Gudea's glass-clear gaps stay put.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-hanken-grotesk: Ruler-straight and unhurried, Bruno Ace lingers on every character, its line a constant width. And Hanken Grotesk, with a wire-bent look and wide channels into each counter, does the quieter work of reading.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-ibm-plex-sans-devana: Ruler-drawn lines of constant width, with no brush-style pressure swell anywhere, are what mark Bruno Ace. IBM Plex Sans Devanagari adds rope-loose curves, a modern foil to that rigidity.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-inclusive-sans: Distinctive and unhurried, Bruno Ace lingers over each character along a ruler-straight line. Inclusive Sans, with rims matching its stems and open-ended curves, keeps paragraph after paragraph reading smoothly.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-jost: Expressive without fuss, Bruno Ace lingers on each character along a ruler-drawn, constant-width line. Jost, with broad terminal gaps and a unit-width stroke, gives it a clean, professional counterweight.
gen-gf-bruno-ace-gf-jura: Jura reads like bent wire, with constant strokes and s curves that open wide at both ends. Bruno Ace belongs in large, brief headlines, where its lingering rhythm can show.
